title: AC-E21 slow-mo not implemented: accumulator cap discards backlog (skips ticks) and no 'can't keep up' telemetry is emitted
evidence:
while accumulator >= tick_len and steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME:
		_do_step()
		accumulator -= tick_len
		steps += 1
	# slow-mo: if still behind after the cap, drop excess so accumulator can't
	# grow unbounded (the sim simply runs slow — AC-E21: never skips ticks).
	if accumulator > tick_len * float(MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME):
		accumulator = tick_len * float(MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME)
(grep: no 'can't keep up' telemetry anywhere in run_controller.gd)
detail: AC-E21/S0.1 require slow-mo that 'never skips ticks' (complete) + 'can't keep up' telemetry. The backlog clamp discards time beyond 5 ticks (those ticks never run) and no telemetry fires. Benign on desktop; violates the pinned slow-mo contract on a slow device.
recommended_fix: Run every queued tick across frames (true slow-mo, fall behind wall-clock) and emit a 'can't keep up' warn when steps hits the frame cap; remove the backlog-discard clamp (or bound it far higher).
